title: setup-python micro pins must match the companion fixtures and version assertions
answers: Python version assertion fails in virtualenv or model tests after bumping setup-python pin
how do I change the pinned Python 3.10 or 3.11 micro version in CI
model environment recreation uses wrong Python micro version
which test resources must change when the setup-python Python version is bumped
body:
Symptom: after a Python micro-version bump, virtualenv/conda model tests fail on the version check or the recreated environment reports the old Python version.
Root cause: .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml (version-selection block under PIN_MICRO_VERSION, per-RUNNER_OS branches) is the source of the pinned micro version, but the same literal is copied into tests/resources/example_virtualenv_project/python_env.yaml, tests/resources/example_virtualenv_no_python_env/python_env.yaml, tests/resources/example_virtualenv_conda_project/conda.yaml, tests/resources/example_mlflow_1x_sklearn_model/MLmodel, conda.yaml and python_env.yaml, the entrypoint.py asserts (sys.version_info check), and the inline MLmodel/python_env strings in tests/sklearn/test_sklearn_model_export.py:test_sklearn_compatible_with_mlflow_2_4_0.
Fix pattern: change the action.yml branch for the OS, then update every fixture and assertion copy of that literal in the same commit. Quote style in python_env.yaml varies (some quoted, some not), so keep each file's existing style.
Constraints: pick versions that the hosted runner image caches, since the pin is meant to avoid downloads; the Linux pins were aligned while macOS 3.11 stayed on a cached 3.11.9. Pins with pin-micro-version: false (e.g. the Copilot code-review job) are not affected.
applies: Any bump of Python micro versions in setup-python or of the fixture files that mirror them.
says: Continuous integration build fails on Python version checks when testing model environments.
Recreated model virtual environments report an outdated Python runtime version in tests.
Update test project fixtures when upgrading Python patch versions in build workflows.
Model packaging tests fail because the environment Python version does not match.
Automated test runs fail asserting the expected Python version in virtual environments.
search: When updating pinned Python micro versions in .github/actions/setup-python/action.yml under PIN_MICRO_VERSION, the identical version literal must be updated across all companion test fixtures and assertions in the same commit. Affected files include example project environment configs (python_env.yaml, conda.yaml, MLmodel), entrypoint.py sys.version_info assertions, and inline strings in tests/sklearn/test_sklearn_model_export.py:test_sklearn_compatible_with_mlflow_2_4_0. Pinned versions should match cached runner images to avoid downloads, preserving existing quote styles in YAML, while workflows with pin-micro-version set to false remain unaffected.
